title_zh: 移开纸张并吸干桌上清水

scenario.goal_zh: 把学习材料移离积水并分工吸干桌面后继续课堂活动

context_zh: 罗莎在手工课桌面打翻一杯清水，桌上没有电器，老师协助她保护纸模型并清理。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Student Rosa
sentences.text: My desk is an absolute mess. I have knocked water over the paper models.

sentences.speaker: Teacher Chen
sentences.text: Put the dry models aside on this tray first. I will lift the wet sheet off the table.

sentences.speaker: Student Rosa
sentences.text: Shall I wipe it up with some paper?

sentences.speaker: Teacher Chen
sentences.text: Use this cloth to absorb the puddle instead. Then we can see which sheets need replacing.

sentences.speaker: Student Rosa
sentences.text: The table is dry now, and these three models were not touched. I only need one new sheet.

sentences.speaker: Teacher Chen
sentences.text: Here you are. Keep the cup on the separate shelf while you finish.

targets.sense_zh: 完全的，十足的；用于加强语气
